The '''Crila Republic''' is an island country and city-state in [[North New Ayre]]. Its territory comprises one main island, [[6 satellite islands]] and islets, and one [[outlying islet]]. The country is bordered by the [[Sahare Gulf]] to the south, and [[Maalle]] across the [[Strait of Crila]] to the east.

Inhabited by [[Jaintl people]] since the 10th century, and prior to that by other [[Indigenous peoples]], the island was originally named "[[Siroaim]]". It was claimed for the [[Crown of Taval]] by [[Taval|Tavalan]] navigators in the mid 14th century, who named it "Crilao", and it first appeared on a Tavalan map in 1511. The [[Easuhuran Empire]] claimed the island between 1431 and 1434, with their only remnants being the introduction of [[wild Wors]] intended as a supply of meat whenever the island was visited. The indigenous population was mostly [[sold into slavery]], killed, or died of disease by this time. During this period, the colony operated on a plantation economy under the [[Maalle Colony]], relying initially on the labour of [[Dahen indentured servants]] and subsequently on [[Massiran slaves]] who worked on the island's [[Wikipedia:Plantation|plantations]]. The island gained independence after the [[Crila War]], when the remnants of the [[KKO]] fled to the island, and in 1646, [[Maalle recognized their independence]]. Becoming the Crila Republic in 1657.

As a [[Wikipedia:Developed_country|developed country]], the Crila Republic has the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|fourth-highest GDP per capita]] in New Ayre. The Crila Republic ranks highly in key social indicators: education, healthcare, housing, peacefulness, passport strength, personal safety, and infrastructure, with a high home-ownership rate. The Crila Republicans enjoy one of the [[longest life expectancies]], fastest Internet connection speeds, a very [[low infant mortality rates]], and one of the lowest levels of [[corruption]] in the world. The Crila Republic is organised into [[five regions,]] [[36 planning areas]] and [[hundreds of subzones]]. It has the [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|third-highest population density]] of any country, although there are numerous green and recreational spaces as a result of urban planning. With a multicultural population and in recognition of the cultural identities of the country's major ethnic groups, the Crila Republic has two official languages: [[Alqiran langauge|Alqiran]] and [[Lastnu lanuage|Lastnu]]. Alqiran is the common language, used exclusively in numerous public services, while Lastnu is the language of government. [[Wikipedia:Multiracialism|Multiracialism]] is enshrined in the constitution and continues to shape national policies.

The Crila Republic is a [[Wikipedia:Presidential_system|presidential republic]]. While it is constitutionally a multi-party democracy where free elections are regularly held, it functions as a de facto [[Wikipedia:Two-party_system|two-party state]], with the [[Dual Democratic Alliance|Dual Democratic Alliance (DDA)]] and [[Foundation Party|Foundation Party (FD)]] maintaining continuous political dominance since 1702. One of the founding collaborators of the [[Democratic Action Council|Democratic Action Council (DAC)]].
